name: dbx 160 Compressor/Limiter (AKG-era, VCA 200 / RMS 208)
description: dbx 160 compressor/limiter, one channel: TL082 balanced input (gain 0.5), dbx VCA (200) with TL082 I/V, feed-forward RMS (208) detector, threshold / ratio side chain (4558), front-panel gain control on the VCA port, LM301 + BC341/BC361 class-AB output on +-24 V with the KE4858 output clamp. Hard knee (this revision has no OverEasy).

sources.title: dbx (AKG Acoustics) SCHEMATIC 160 COMP/LIMITER, ref. assembly dwg 260182 (archive.org 'dbx_160-161-162_Schematic', PDF p.18; p.19 a second copy)
dbx 160/161 brochure specifications (ratio, threshold 10 mV-3 V, release 120 dB/s)
dbx 160/161 initial procedure (alignment: level cal -0.011 V at 1.228 Vrms, both LEDs off at threshold)
dbx MOD 160/161 simplified schematics (VCA & RMS, RMS & meter control, output buffer): cross-check of the block topology and of dbx's 'unity / 1/100' side-chain description
THAT Corporation 2252 data sheet (the rms law used inside the RMS 208 model)

TL082.note: TI TL082 (TL08x data sheet): AVD 200 V/mV, GBW 3 MHz, SR 13 V/us, +-13.5 V swing; the library TL072 card's values (same die, the TL072 is the low-noise grade)

LM301_10P.note: National LM301A: AVOL 160 V/mV typ, supply current 1.8 mA; with the standard 30 pF single-pole compensation unity-gain 1 MHz, 0.5 V/us (S). C26 is 10 pF here, so GBW and slew are scaled by 30/10 (D: both are set by the compensation capacitor). Rails from the supply pins

BC341.note: BC341 (60 V, 1 A NPN, hFE 63-250): bf at the band's geometric mean; is/br approximate, no vendor SPICE card (A)

BC361.note: BC361 (60 V, 1 A PNP, complement of BC341): as BC341 (A)

BC261.note: BC261 small-signal PNP; generic small-signal values (A)

KE4858.note: Teledyne KE4858 = 2N4858 switch: IDSS 8-80 mA, VGS(off) -0.8..-4 V, rDS(on) <= 60 ohm, Crss 8 pF (S); vto -2 V and IDSS 25 mA (beta = IDSS/vto^2) inside the bands give rDS(on) 40 ohm (D). It is held off (gate at -24 V) in operation

DBX200_CORE.note: core of the dbx 'VCA (200)' module (subcircuit vca200): four separate core bases (P0 P1 N0 N1), no control buffer, so rc 0 and rsym 0. The module's law is 3.05 mV/dB at its base pins = VT*ln10/20 at the 35 C chip of the RMS card, i.e. the classic one-junction-per-path Blackmer cell (D): the 24.9K / 200 ohm || 200 ohm divider puts the GAIN CONTROL's +-15 V ends at +-60.0 mV on the control pins, which the panel marks +-20 dB (3.0 mV/dB), and the side chain feeds the control pins half the detector's 6.1 mV/dB at the ratio pot's infinity end. iq 20 uA assumed (A); no 200 distortion data is published: vsym / rs are the library DBX202 card's (its successor module; fitted to the THAT 202R, A). rs > 0 is also what keeps ngspice's .op on the physical root (with rs 0 its Newton lands on a 10 kV root of the I/V op-amp)

RMS208_CORE.note: the log-domain RMS law of the THAT 2252 card (2VT ln, 6.1 mV/dB at a 35 C chip, Iin0 = sqrt(IBIAS IT)/2.9). vofs 0: the 208's internal level is unknown, so its output is 0 V at the core's Iin0 (A); the level-cal network (R63/R64) sets the absolute calibration as on the hardware

parts.note: the engine's vca is the two-junction-per-path cell (2VT per neper, 6.1 mV/dB) with a fixed 1.3 V idle drop per path, which does not converge below about 5 mV/dB; the 200's one-junction law (VT per neper, 3.05 mV/dB at the bases) is the same exponential at twice the base voltage. The bases draw no current (beta ideal), so this x2 is a pure change of scale onto the core's Ec+ and SYM ...
the detector core: a log-domain squarer / log stage whose log transistor writes the internal node c
IBIAS set inside the module: the THAT 2252 application value (560 kOhm, 23 uA) (A); the 208 has no IBIAS pin
polarity of the 208: the log transistor sinks from the timing node (the CAP sits below ground and the timing current is sourced from +15 V through R35). c is held at -V(out) ...
... the log current is sensed across 1 ohm (1 uV per uA, negligible against the 26 mV junction) ...

... and drawn from OUT/CAP. Net: C15 dV/dt = IT(R35) - Iin^2 k exp((V(out))/VT)/IBIAS, so OUT falls 6.1 mV/dB with level and releases at IT/C15. Behavioural glue around the library law (the module is potted; no internal schematic is published)

controls.label: Dry
controls.note: the 160 has no dry/wet mix. Stored only

controls.note: no side-chain filter: the detector is fed from OA3 through C11 0.33 uF / R38 23.2K only. Stored only

controls.label: Sidechain
controls.note: no key input on this card (the stereo-strap / detector jack is an option). Stored only

controls.label: Below
controls.note: the BELOW LED (CR10) is netlisted (node p48 lit when OA5 is above +0.5 V); no knob. Stored only

controls.label: Above
controls.note: the ABOVE LED (CR11) is netlisted; no knob. Stored only

controls.label: VU Mode
controls.note: S2 meter function (INPUT / OUTPUT / GAIN CHANGE) drives only the VU meter circuit, which is not netlisted (notes); the GR meter is the readout. Stored only

M1 'VCA (200)' (dbx potted module; legend IN GND P1 N1 P0 / +V -V N0 OUT). Two control pins (N0 and the pin beside it, P1) are tied to the control node; P0 carries the SYM VCA trim (R28 300K, R25 22 ohm to ground) and N1 is grounded. The tied pair is the cell's Ec+ side and P0/N1 its Ec- side: the FRONT PANEL GAIN CONTROL is marked +20 dB at its +15 V (CW) end and feeds the control node positive, and the side chain drives it negative when the level is above threshold. N1 is merged with P0 into the engine cell's single Ec- node (P0 sits at 0 V with the trim centred). GND = ground. crops (1300,540) 2x, (1310,640) 4x, (1150,620) 1.6x; pin legend (2180,530) 5x

gr.note: GR meter: OA5B's output node w5 (after R46) drives the VCA control port through R48 200 ohm into R30 200 ohm || the 24.9K from the GAIN CONTROL, i.e. 0.4983 of w5; at the 200's 3.05 mV/dB that is 163.4 dB per volt. Measured on this circuit (1 kHz, compression 0.5 and 1, threshold 0 and 0.5): GR = -163.4 * w5 within 0.05 dB from 2 to 59.5 dB. The GAIN CONTROL is not on w5, so the reading is compression only (the hardware's GAIN CHANGE meter has its own offset for the gain control, R51). Positive w5 (the 1/100 branch below threshold, up to +0.6 dB of gain at threshold CW) reads 0.
